annotation.title_clean: 15 CFR Part 791—Securing the Information and Communications Technology and Services Supply Chain (incl. Subpart D: Connected Vehicles)
annotation.title_en: 15 CFR Part 791—Securing the Information and Communications Technology and Services Supply Chain (incl. Subpart D: Connected Vehicles)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security
annotation.venue: Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR / Federal Register)
annotation.summary_en: US Commerce Department regulation (15 CFR Part 791) setting procedures to review and prohibit ICTS transactions involving foreign adversaries. Subpart D bans Chinese- and Russian-linked connected-vehicle software and hardware, including for automated driving systems, and requires Declarations of Conformity, authorizations, recordkeeping and IEEPA penalties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Secretary of Commerce may review ICTS transactions involving foreign adversaries and prohibit or mitigate them.
Scope covers critical and emerging technologies including AI, autonomous and uncrewed systems, robotics, and drones.
Subpart D prohibits importing or selling connected vehicles with PRC/Russia-linked VCS hardware or covered software, including ADS.
Manufacturers and importers must file Declarations of Conformity with SBOM/HBOM-backed due diligence.
General and specific authorizations, appeals, 10-year recordkeeping, and IEEPA civil and criminal penalties apply.
